**B. Fee simple subject to condition subsequent.** The grant uses "provided, however, that if... then the grantor... may re-enter," which creates a right of re-entry (power of termination) in the grantor. That is the mark of a condition subsequent. It is not a durational limitation like "so long as," and the estate doesn't end automatically. My earlier answer of A was wrong.

CONFIDENCE: 88
